changelog:
Initial release of Work IM Avatar Generator.

- Upload a photo to generate a polished, business-style IM avatar with AI.
- Supports custom instructions for backgrounds and outfits (e.g., gray background, business suit).
- Requires API key from wsdsocial.com for access.
- Simple API usage with cURL example provided.
- Returns avatar image URL in JSON response.
summary: AI-powered professional IM avatar generator. Upload a personal photo and get a clean, high-end business-style headshot — no influencer glamour, just polished...
